title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
summary: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.
reason: TechCrunch report on Netflix's AI 'Discover' recommendation tab is a consumer streaming UI feature. No named AI model/version (1-1 excludes generic product features), no research artifact, no financing/M&A/partnership/market data, no policy action, and no open-source tooling.
